source: Supplied timestamped transcript plus bounded acoustic observations; transcription remains an editorial reading, not verified author lyrics.

selectedTextVariants.basis: Unconstrained vocal recognition and narrowed original/vocal windows support the normal verb; competing recognizer misspellings remain diagnostic.
Narrow original/vocal and full original passes favor the singular possessive; conditioned likelihood alone is not a listener verdict.
Quiet initial preposition is consistent across full/narrow original and vocal recognizers; character confidence is low, retained as interpretive uncertainty.

nonlyricSoundTreatment.treatment: Preserved original soundtrack; title and illustration, no lexical lyric events.
Preserved and ornament responds. No invented independent vowel-word timestamps or asserted count.
Preserved source sound/picture, no recognizer-invented continuation caption.

limits: Unconstrained recognition, conditioned attention, MMS cores, signal diagnostics and source/target invariants support the selected preview. Same-family variants are correlated. Acceptance and encoded evidence are distinct from millisecond acoustic certification.
